==English==

===Etymology===
* As an English surname, from the adjective {{m|en|new}}.
* Also as an English surname, from a misdivision of {{der|en|enm|atten}} {{m|enm|ew|t=at the yew}}.
* As a {{der|en|de|-}} and Jewish surname, Americanized from {{m|en|Neu}}.
* As a {{der|en|zh|-}} surname, from a Romanization of {{m|zh|牛}} (see {{m|en|Niu}}) and {{m|zh|梁}} (see {{m|en|Liang}}).
